name: Chat Messenger
description: Real-time 1:1 and group chat between site users via AJAX long-polling, with emoji reactions, presence, typing indicators, read receipts, profile-picture avatars, contacts/blocking and private file attachments.

suggests.drupal/ai: ^1.4, to generate quick-reply suggestions with an AI provider instead of the built-in rule-based ones

project_description: Chat Messenger adds a complete real-time messaging system to a Drupal site: one-to-one and group conversations, live message delivery, typing indicators, emoji reactions, presence status, profile-picture avatars, read/delivered receipts and file attachments — all built on a standard Drupal stack. It requires no separate chat server, WebSocket service, Node.js, or Redis: live updates are delivered by a bounded AJAX long-poll endpoint served by ordinary PHP-FPM workers, with a DB-backed concurrency guard to cap how many workers pollers can occupy at once. A floating launcher button is added site-wide for discoverability. Attachments are stored under private:// and gated to conversation members via hook_file_download(). Optional quick-reply suggestions are rule-based out of the box, or AI-generated through the suggested (not required) drupal/ai module. Typical use cases include community sites, membership portals, educational platforms, corporate intranets and social networks.
